![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945962/assets/40143c20622029d70a978310a7d38bc41d7b8411151d3d5f61a3b280e5807841.png)

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of an object. At what times is the object accelerating?
worked_solution:
The object is accelerating when its acceleration is positive. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is positive.

We see from the graph that the slope is positive from $t=0\,\text{s}$ to $t=30\,\text{s}.$ Therefore, the object is accelerating in this time interval.

Question 12
?

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of an object. At what times is the object accelerating?

a
From 0s to 30s
b
From 30s to 70s
c
From 0s to 70s
d
From 30s to 80s
e
From 70s to 80s
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The object is accelerating when its acceleration is positive. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is positive.

We see from the graph that the slope is positive from t=0s to t=30s. Therefore, the object is accelerating in this time interval.
